domainFacts: fsi_cd_evidencetype deliberately uses values 1-6 rather than Dataverse default 100000000+ values; Test Result is 5 and cross-solution-integration hardcodes that mapping.
The Control Assessment table is UserOwned and uses fsi_controlmasterid as a lookup to fsi_controlmaster plus fsi_assessor as a systemuser lookup.

The shipped sample-data/control-master.json contains 78 controls, with README counts of 29 security, 26 operations, 14 monitoring, and 9 data governance controls. The framework baseline is now 79 controls — control 2.27 (Consumption-Entitlement Governance) is NOT in the shipped sample. Do not 'correct' the 78 counts to 79 without regenerating the dataset and the PillarDimension DATATABLE in docs/dax-measures.md.
Get-ExchangeComplianceData.ps1 treats inactive shared or unused mailboxes as mailboxSettings.userPurpose-based or disabled-account signals, not mailbox permission-grant enumeration.
docs/dataverse-schema.md is the deployment source for Compliance Dashboard option values; renumbering fsi_cd_evidencetype requires a coordinated minor-bump with cross-solution-integration.
